statements:
CREATE TABLE product_history (
  history_id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
  id UUID NOT NULL,
  _version BIGINT NOT NULL,
  operation TEXT NOT NULL,
  "data" JSONB NOT NULL,
  recorded_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT clock_timestamp() NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT product_history_pkey PRIMARY KEY (history_id)
)
COMMENT ON TABLE product_history IS 'Version history for product'

steps.subject: table/product_history/index/idx_product_history_id_recorded

statements: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_product_history_id_version ON product_history USING BTREE (id, _version)
steps.subject: table/product_history/index/uq_product_history_id_version
function/product_capture_history

hazards.reason: Seeding product_history writes one image of every row of product while the new triggers' lock blocks writes to it.
hazards.subject: table/product_history

statements:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_product_bump_version
  BEFORE UPDATE ON product
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION product_capture_history()

CREATE TRIGGER trg_product_capture_history_write
  AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON product
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION product_capture_history()

CREATE TRIGGER trg_product_capture_history_delete
  AFTER DELETE ON product
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION product_capture_history()

INSERT INTO product_history (id, _version, operation, data)
SELECT src.id, src._version, 'INSERT', to_jsonb(src)
FROM product AS src
